dessin:
A horizontal timeline across the sheet at 57% of the height, from 4% to 76% of the width: a thick ink line ending on the right with an open solid arrowhead. Small year cells (short vertical ticks every 4% of width) only between 34% and 62% of the width.
Two milestones on the timeline: a tall vertical ink tick with a round dot at 34% of the width, and another at 62% of the width.
At the start of the timeline, top left (x 4-17%, y 24-50%): a pale document sheet with an official round seal pictogram in it (a government contract).
Next to it (x 19-29%, y 28-46%): a small pale card with two standing human silhouettes.
Above the timeline between the milestones (x 44-55%, y 24-46%): a pale format sheet with a simple map pattern inside (parcels and a road).
Left of it (x 33-39%, y 24-48%): three tiny software windows stacked vertically, each with a title bar.
From each tiny window, a thin red route (#C4472B, round caps) goes right into the format sheet (three converging red routes).
On the far right, away from the timeline (x 82-94%, y 26-44%): a small pale card with a little house pictogram and a location pin (headquarters).
Keep empty: the area below the timeline (y 60-80%) everywhere.

elements.frise: the horizontal timeline line with its arrowhead (without the milestones)
elements.contrat: the document sheet with the round seal at the top left
elements.fondateurs: the small card with two human silhouettes
elements.jalon1993: the left milestone tick with its dot on the timeline
elements.cases: the small year cell ticks between the two milestones
elements.saif: the format sheet with the map pattern above the timeline
elements.fenetres: the three tiny stacked software windows left of the format sheet
elements.routes: the red routes from the tiny windows into the format sheet
elements.jalon1996: the right milestone tick with its dot on the timeline
elements.siege: the small card with the house and location pin on the far right
